Speaking before a glittering audience of princes, viceregal dignitaries, and elite Congress leaders, Gandhi delivered a stirring critique: 'It is a matter of deep humiliation and shame for us that I am compelled this evening under the shadow of this great university to address my countrymen in a language that is foreign to me... Look at the richly bedizened princes sitting on this dais. There is no salvation for India unless you strip yourselves of this jewellery and hold it in trust for your countrymen in India. There is no salvation for India as long as the vast millions of our peasants remain impoverished and forgotten. Our salvation can only come through the farmer; neither the lawyers, nor the doctors, nor the rich landlords are going to secure it.'"

According to Gandhi's prophetic declaration at BHU, through which social class alone could India's genuine salvation be achieved?

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Mahatma Gandhi transformed the Indian National Congress from an elite, English-speaking debating club into a mass political organization.
Statement II: Gandhi adopted the dress of ordinary poor peasants (the loincloth and charkha) to demonstrate his deep identification with the poorest Indian masses.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies that both statements contain factual errors.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement I is correct: Under Gandhi's leadership, peasants, workers, and women joined Congress by millions.
2. Statement II is correct: He discarded western suits for homespun khadi and loincloth in 1921 to identify with the poor.
Hence, Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
